_doc: How each weapon class sits in the right hand, in REST (T-pose) character terms [right, forward, up]: `blade` is where the weapon's +Y points, `edge` where its +Z (cutting edge) faces, `pos` the grip point in hand-bone space (Godot: x forward, y toward the fingers, z into the palm). `left_at` is where the left hand closes on the haft, metres along the blade from the grip (negative = toward the pommel). tools/anim/grip.py turns this into clip_meta.json mounts (weapon@<class>); build_combat_lib.py poses hands with the same numbers.
